name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U)
short_description: Housing assistance for eligible EWS/LIG/MIG urban families without a pucca house.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹2.50 lakh for house construction or interest subsidy on home loans.
benefit_amount: Up to ₹2.50 lakh assistance / 4% interest subsidy (verify current PMAY-U 2.0 guidelines)

eligibility_rules.label: Family income is within ₹6 lakh (EWS up to ₹3L / LIG up to ₹6L)
Family does not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Applicant is an adult (18 years or older)

required_documents: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house
Identity and residence proof on official portal
application_steps: Check EWS/LIG/MIG income vertical on PMAY-U 2.0 portal
Submit required documents at ULB/CSC or official portal
disclaimer: Female family head/co-ownership is prioritized under PMAY guidelines.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
short_description: Health assurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_summary: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empanelled hospitals.

eligibility_rules.label: Family falls within low-income / SECC / ration card eligibility threshold (≤ ₹2.5 lakh)

required_documents: Income certificate or SECC inclusion proof
Official identity proof at Ayushman Mitra desk
application_steps: Complete e-KYC at nearest CSC or Empanelled Hospital
disclaimer: Senior citizens aged 70+ are additionally covered regardless of income per recent expansion.

name: Kalibai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty & Higher Education Yojana
short_description: Merit-cum-means support for meritorious female students in Rajasthan pursuing higher education.
ministry: Department of College Education, Govt. of Rajasthan
benefit_summary: Free scooty / financial incentive and higher education support for meritorious girl students of Rajasthan.
benefit_amount: Scooty + financial support (or ₹40,000 cash equivalent per state notice)

eligibility_rules.label: Family annual income is within ₹2.5 lakh
Passed Class XII with at least 65% (RBSE) / 75% (CBSE)

application_steps: Log in to Rajasthan SSO portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in)
Submit Jan Aadhaar, marksheet and income certificate
disclaimer: Check current academic session cutoffs on hte.rajasthan.gov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Rajshri / Lado Protsahan Yojana (Rajasthan)
short_description: Financial assistance for the education, health, and empowerment of daughters and women in Rajasthan.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Govt. of Rajasthan
target_group: Women and girl children in Rajasthan
benefit_summary: Staggered financial assistance from birth through higher education for girl child empowerment in Rajasthan.
benefit_amount: Up to ₹1,00,000 in milestone installments (verify current WCD notice)

eligibility_rules.label: Beneficiary is female / mother of girl child
Family annual income is within ₹3 lakh

required_documents: School/college enrollment proof for later installments
application_steps: Register birth at government/empanelled medical institution in Rajasthan
Link Jan Aadhaar card at Anganwadi or e-Mitra center
Track milestone installments via WCD / Jan Soochna portal
disclaimer: Installments are disbursed across education and health milestones.
